items.raw_excerpt: Seeing edible lychees discarded for their cosmetic imperfections leads a central Queensland grower to use the third-grade fruit for alcohol.
items.summary_en: A central Queensland lychee grower saw good edible lychees being thrown away because they did not look perfect. Now the grower uses that third-grade fruit to make alcohol instead.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즐랜드 중부의 리치 농가가 외관이 고르지 않다는 이유로 버려지던 먹을 수 있는 열매를 발견했습니다. 이제 농가는 그 3등급 과일을 이용해 술을 만들고 있습니다.
items.title_en: A grower turns imperfect lychees into alcohol

items.title_original: Imperfect lychees go from shed floor to liquor shelf as growers diversify

items.raw_excerpt: Scientists are trialing using environmental DNA to track signs of yellow-legged hornets in Auckland waterways, with hornet queens potentially coming out of winter hibernation soon.
items.summary_en: Scientists are testing a new way to find yellow-legged hornets in Auckland. They search for traces of DNA in the water. This could track hornets as they wake from winter sleep.
items.summary_ko: 과학자들이 오클랜드 수로에서 노란다리 말벌을 찾는 새 방법을 시험하고 있다. 물 속에서 DNA 흔적을 찾아내는 방식이다. 겨울잠에서 깨어나는 말벌을 추적하는 데 도움이 될 수 있다.
items.title_en: DNA clues help find hornets in Auckland waterways
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 수로에서 말벌 찾는 DNA 단서
items.title_original: 'Game changing': DNA clues track hornets in Auckland waterways

items.summary_en: About 100 volunteers help at a small hospital in Alliston, Ontario. They knit finger puppets for children, run the gift shop, and greet patients at the door. Their kindness keeps a friendly, small-town feeling alive in the hospital.
items.summary_ko: 온타리오 앨리스턴의 작은 병원에서 약 백 명의 자원봉사자들이 환자와 방문객을 돕습니다. 아이들에게는 뜨개질한 손가락 인형을 나눠 주고, 선물 가게를 운영하며, 병원 입구에서 방문객을 다정하게 맞이합니다. 이들의 정성이 병원에 정겨운 시골 분위기를 간직하게 하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Ontario hospital volunteers keep small-town warmth alive
items.title_ko: 온타리오 시골 병원, 자원봉사자들이 지키는 작은 마을의 온기

items.summary_en: A complaint filed by former Liberal MLA Leanne Castley about alleged threatening behaviour by fellow MLA Chiaka Barry should be dismissed. The ACT Commissioner for Standards recommended rejecting the complaint.

items.summary_en: Residents of central-west Brazil, including the capital, saw a solar halo in the sky. An expert says it is a common natural physical phenomenon, unrelated to solar temperatures or harmful radiation.

items.summary_en: Arthur Jantjies, who comes from the small town of Hopetown, won the Two Oceans marathon in Cape Town. Gerda Steyn won the women's race for the seventh time. Jantjies says this win is a big step in his career.

items.summary_en: A parentless student in Odisha has wrong parents' names on his documents. Because of this, he cannot get government help and his schooling suffers. The state rights panel is investigating the case.

items.raw_excerpt: Under the new itinerary, these select sailings from Singapore will include a visit to Langkawi on Day 3. Guests can either explore Langkawi independently or book shore excursions, known as Port Adventures, through Disney Cruise Line.
items.summary_en: Disney Adventure will add a day trip to Langkawi on some four-night cruises from Singapore. The new sailings start on Dec 31. Guests can explore Langkawi on their own or join shore excursions called Port Adventures.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite plans to build new facilities, the Queensland Land Court finds Brampton Island resort is "dilapidated to the point of falling down" with the owners in breach of lease conditions.
items.summary_en: A court in Queensland found that Brampton Island's resort is badly run down and close to falling down. The owners broke the conditions of their lease. The court ruled that the tourism lease can be cancelled.

items.title_original: Court rules tropical island owner can be stripped of lease

items.raw_excerpt: The new 8.86-second sprint mark beat the previous robot record of 9.39 seconds. It's also faster than Jamaican Usain Bolt’s 100m world record time of 9.58 seconds.
items.summary_en: A Chinese humanoid robot ran 100m in 8.86 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. The time beat the old robot record of 9.39 seconds. It is also faster than Usain Bolt's human world record of 9.58 seconds.

items.title_en: Chinese humanoid robot sets new 100m sprint record in Beijing

items.title_original: Chinese humanoid robot sets new 100m sprint record at Beijing Games

items.raw_excerpt: Members of an Asian theatre group hope a play set in the country's poll tax era can prompt audiences to rethink their attitudes towards immigrants.
items.summary_en: An Asian theatre group in New Zealand is putting on a play about the country's poll tax era. The play shows how Chinese immigrants were treated long ago. The group hopes it will change how audiences think about immigrants today.
